text.text_excerpt: Love to grab eats here! They serve breakfast and lunch, but I'm not sure about dinner. This is pure soul food, and it's delicious with a nice selection on the menu. The two warnings are that parking is a bear and the appearance of the place may create concern. The area where you order your food makes you think it's a take-out only place, but there's a nice dining room with big screen TV's beyond the door. :-) Breakfast is great--a wide variety of the usual breakfast offerings with a soul food twist. Lunch is awesome. You get big portions for all of your meals at very reasonable prices. You may even consider eating some now, and saving the rest for later which helps stretch the dollar quit...

I finally got to try this place! I passed it up one time and was curious of how the food was. There is a small parking lot for customers, The waiting room was large with huge poster menu on the wall. One of the ladies popped her head out of the ordering window and I ordered the Red Beans and Rice with Fried Chicken, a Smothered Pork Chop, Bread Pudding, and their freshly squeezed lemonade. I just waited a few minutes and my food was already ready at the pick up window! Damn, that was fast! There were no tables around, but I saw a door to who knows leads where. I asked the lady who took my order if it was a dining room and she told me there were tables there and it doesn't close until 5PM....

Another great "hole in the wall" business (seriously, the first time you come here you may accidentally pass it up) that does soul food/home cooked meals justice. The staff is very friendly and fairly quick with processing your to go orders. On rare occasions I may receive dry cornbread or overdone chicken but as I said, rare. Give these people a try. Reasonably priced plates if you ask me. I usually visit 3 times a week.
